title: Gossip Protocol
subtitle: News spreads through random whispers in about log N rounds, with no coordinator to lose
motto: Tell a few, and let them tell a few
keyInsight: Gossip reaches every node in a handful of rounds with no single point of failure, but it sends far more messages than a central broadcast and leaves nodes briefly disagreeing.

decisions.title: Compare with a central monitor honestly
decisions.description: The first frame is a working central broadcast, so the sim shows gossip sending about eight times more messages, and the win is in the busiest node and in surviving failures.
decisions.alternatives: Pitting gossip against a broken baseline would hide its message cost.

decisions.title: Use a seeded random generator
decisions.description: Random peer choice is real randomness, drawn from a fixed seed so the rounds and message counts repeat exactly.
decisions.alternatives: An averaged formula for rounds would hide that a lossy network takes visibly longer.
